questions.question_text: Tell me about yourself and why you are interested in this position.
questions.follow_up_question: What specific aspect of our company culture or mission resonates most with you?

questions.question_text: What are your greatest professional strengths and one area you are working to improve?
questions.follow_up_question: Can you give a recent example where you actively applied feedback to improve that area?

questions.question_text: Where do you see yourself professionally in the next three to five years?
questions.follow_up_question: How does this specific role help you achieve that long-term career milestone?

questions.question_text: How do you maintain a healthy work-life balance and handle high-pressure deadlines?
questions.follow_up_question: What tools or daily habits do you use to stay organized when priorities shift abruptly?

questions.question_text: Why should we hire you over other qualified candidates applying for this role?
questions.follow_up_question: What is the single biggest value you expect to deliver within your first 90 days?

questions.question_text: What is the difference between synchronous and asynchronous programming, and when would you use each?
questions.follow_up_question: How do you handle error propagation in asynchronous workflows?

questions.question_text: Explain the concept of REST APIs and the significance of HTTP status codes like 200, 404, and 500.
questions.follow_up_question: What is the difference between PUT and PATCH in RESTful resource mutation?

questions.question_text: Explain how database indexing works and the trade-offs between read and write performance.
questions.follow_up_question: When would adding an index actually degrade overall database performance?

questions.question_text: What are the core principles of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) and how do you apply SOLID design principles?
questions.follow_up_question: Can you explain the Dependency Inversion Principle with a real-world software example?

questions.question_text: How would you design a distributed caching layer to prevent cache stampede and ensure high availability?
questions.follow_up_question: How would you handle cache invalidation during a multi-region database write?

questions.question_text: Describe how you approach troubleshooting a sudden memory leak in a production backend microservice.
questions.follow_up_question: What alerting thresholds would you configure to detect memory degradation before out-of-memory crashes occur?

questions.question_text: Tell me about a time you collaborated with a challenging teammate. How did you handle it?
questions.follow_up_question: What did you learn about your own interpersonal style from that interaction?

questions.question_text: Describe a project where you had to quickly learn a new technology or skill to deliver results.
questions.follow_up_question: How did you validate that your implementation met best practices despite being new to the tool?

questions.question_text: Tell me about a time a project you were leading did not go as planned. How did you respond?
questions.follow_up_question: How did you communicate the roadblock to leadership or affected stakeholders?

questions.question_text: Describe a situation where you had to make an important technical or business decision with incomplete information.
questions.follow_up_question: If you had to make that same decision today with more experience, what would you do differently?

questions.question_text: Tell me about a time you strongly disagreed with a senior leader's strategic direction. How did you navigate the conversation?
questions.follow_up_question: Once the final decision was made, how did you ensure your team stayed fully motivated and aligned?
